overview: This enum chooses which footstep sound family a character uses on each ground surface.

None.technical: uint8 value 0 and the CharacterSound row constructor default. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to -1. The footstep notify checks the index before reading MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep, so no footstep sound plays.

ShoesMan.simple: Footsteps sound like a man wearing shoes.
ShoesMan.technical: uint8 value 1. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to array index 0. The notify reads MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep at that index and plays the named SoundEffect row as 3D audio at the foot location. All eight exported ground rows have six entries. 19 exported CharacterSound rows use it.

ShoesWoman.simple: Footsteps sound like a woman wearing shoes.
ShoesWoman.technical: uint8 value 2. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to array index 1. The notify plays the named SoundEffect row from MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep at that index as 3D audio. Seven exported CharacterSound rows use it.

BareFoot.technical: uint8 value 3. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to array index 2. The notify plays the named SoundEffect row from MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep at that index as 3D audio. Fourteen exported CharacterSound rows use it.

Zori.technical: uint8 value 4. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to array index 3. The notify plays the named SoundEffect row from MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep at that index as 3D audio. Six exported CharacterSound rows use it.

Gorilla.simple: Footsteps sound like a gorilla walk.
Gorilla.technical: uint8 value 5. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to array index 4. The notify plays the named SoundEffect row from MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep at that index as 3D audio. Four exported CharacterSound rows use it.

Totality.simple: Footsteps use the Totality sound family.
Totality.technical: uint8 value 6. GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex converts it to array index 5. The notify plays the named SoundEffect row from MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep at that index as 3D audio. Four exported CharacterSound rows use it.

Invalid.technical: uint8 value 255. The conversion yields index 254, which exceeds every exported six-entry footstep array. No exported CharacterSound row uses it and there is no explicit Invalid branch.

notes: Characters expose the stored value through GetFootstepType. Shikigami and sequencer NPCs resolve the same CharacterSound row field for their footstep type.
GameAnimNotify_TypeIndex subtracts 1 from the stored value. The six real footstep types use indices 0 through 5 of MapGround.Id_SoundEffect_Footstep.
The footstep visual effect is chosen by EGameFootstepActionType through a separate index conversion.
Two exported CharacterSound rows use None. Invalid appears only in the header.
